author: tomas
text: sc-158: X-Forwarded-For only (not Forwarded/X-Real-IP), rightmost untrusted hop (not leftmost: leftmost is client-written and spoofable even via a trusted proxy). Bad TRUSTED_PROXIES entries fail at startup rather than at first login. uvicorn's own --forwarded-allow-ips (default 127.0.0.1) is untouched; the Dockerfile is outside my footprint, and both rules agree since a rewritten client.host is simply an untrusted peer here.

author: ansel
text: 036 clarify (self-answered): (1) AC5 realm: no known-realm list exists and a WCL lookup per item is out of scope, so a realm-form rule: words of letters/digits joined by single space/hyphen/apostrophe, optional '(Suffix)', <=24 chars (longest real realm I know: 'Culte de la Rive noire', 22). Stored spelling unchanged; REST entry unchanged. Prose like 'Ignore all previous instructions' fails; very short prose can't be ruled out without a list -> backlog. (2) AC1: RECENT RUNS uses zone_name only; the RECENTLY SEEN tracked-raid label falls back to the report title when WCL gave no guild/zone/date, so that entry shows the report code only. (3) AC3: class/spec mapped via the existing roster.resolve_spec; class kept alone when only the class resolves; unknown -> null. (4) AC4: reason-only rows = codes invalid_name/realm/region/item, the same set the server's follow-up line already hides; duplicate/limit/not_found rows passed the identity rules, so they keep the name.

author: ansel
text: sc-222: identity is set right before the stream and reset via its token in the turn's existing finally (not set for the preamble build, which doesn't need it). background.spawn runs each task in a fresh empty contextvars.Context, as the story suggests: checked every ContextVar (current_identity, wcl refresh actor, wcl lane, model_retry current_turn); jobs set the background lane themselves and the others default to None, which is right for a job. Migration 0017 replaces the tenant_isolation policy with tenant_user_isolation (tenant AND user); policies OR together, so adding a second one would not narrow anything. Downgrade restores the tenant-only policy.

author: ansel
text: sc-223: per-tenant pg_advisory_xact_lock taken in repo.add_character (REST and proposals) and once at the start of proposal approval, before re-validation, so re-validation is authoritative under the lock. Advisory lock over FOR UPDATE on tenants: a tenants row lock would contend with every FK insert's KEY SHARE lock. Postgres only; SQLite tests have no concurrency. Working copy keyed by (identity, target).

author: ansel
text: sc-225: approve applies the re-validated items in bulk (one INSERT batch for adds, one UPDATE flush for role changes, one DELETE ... IN for removes) on the profile rows already loaded under the lock, instead of a savepoint + duplicate check + count per item. Per-item savepoints go: under the lock nothing else can conflict, and an unexpected IntegrityError rolls the whole approve back (proposal stays pending, retry works). The _decide status read was already folded into the locked transaction by sc-242 (034), so nothing left there. Reads: list_proposals/get_proposal take an optional session; conversations.get_conversation and the ws capture transaction pass theirs. Guide fan-out: one spawned task per approval runs its character guides with a local semaphore of 3.

author: tomas
text: sc-176: (a) memory is process-wide, not per user: a 429 is the project's quota, so one user's 429 should spare everyone else the wait. 5 min (RATE_LIMIT_MEMORY_S). (b) A remembered turn still keeps TurnStats.model = the chosen model and emits the usual model_fallback record, so the UI shows 'switched to X' and decision 24 (selection unchanged) holds. (c) If both models are remembered, the turn starts normally on the chosen one. (d) Not done: one shared wait budget per turn (in the ticket's suggestions, not the AC); with the short primary the worst case is ~10 s + the sibling's 90 s budget. Posting as backlog. (e) Risk: generate_with_fallback = UNKNOWN in GitNexus; text search: every chat model request (RetryingGemini/RetryingClaude), so treated as HIGH; mitigation: all 21 feature-021 fallback tests unchanged and green + 7 new.
